node.title: Structural Awareness — Collective Residual Intersections and Recognizable Opportunities
node.summary: Contenido de la fuente: 1. What the original portfolio really establishes · 2. SA-M1 — what the complement of a union actually represents · 3. SA-M2 — why a useful intersection requires a second kind of information.

relations: A task-specific collective property could support a minimal handoff, but it must not erase the piece identity and provenance needed by the receiving decision.
Es una posibilidad de diseño, no un sistema de autenticidad validado ni sustituto de identificar la pieza cuando la pregunta lo exige.
